key_insight: RunningTab keeps a separate environment-side task tab that tracks requirements, seen evidence, and unopened files so an LLM agent can better complete workspace-based tasks without losing track of missing deliverables.
engineering_relevance: This is relevant for building more reliable file-aware agents, especially in terminal or workspace automation settings where important details can fall out of the model context window.
method: Agent records task requirements into a shared environment-side tab.
Environment logs file reads as excerpts with provenance and unopened listed files as candidates.
Agent matches each requirement to excerpts/candidates, resolves it, or marks it with a reason; a finish check blocks premature completion.
evidence_signal: The paper reports validation on three benchmarks with three LLMs, where RunningTab consistently outperforms plain DWI and model-side record baselines.
watch_item: The approach adds environment-state management and finish-check logic, so implementation complexity and synchronization between agent and environment may be a practical concern.
paper_title: RunningTab: Direct Workspace Interaction with Environment-Side Tabs
